title: Question 27
passage:
Would you rather sit near the screen or farther back?
A. The movie lasts almost two hours. B. Either is fine, as long as we’re on the aisle. C. I turned off the screen after the film.
passageZh:
你比較想坐在靠近螢幕的地方，還是坐後面一點？
A. 這部電影將近兩小時。 B. 前面或後面都可以，只要是靠走道的位置。 C. 電影結束後我關了螢幕。
